status: Recommended seven-volume editorial proposal; final packaging and typeset budgets pending
policy: Volume allocation is a dependency-compatible presentation overlay. Global chapter numbers and stable IDs remain unchanged. A volume is a reference/teaching resource, not a requirement to finish all previous volumes.

volumes.title: Foundations of Quantum Computing
volumes.role: Mathematical bridges, states, circuits, measurement and protocols, followed by computational/access/resource models. Chapter 14 is placed here to complete a first-course foundation without requiring advanced information theory.

volumes.title: Quantum Information, Communication, and Security
volumes.role: Channels, distinguishability, inference, entropy, compression, entanglement manipulation and security. This advanced information route is optional before the first algorithm or compiler course.

volumes.title: Quantum Algorithms and Their Limits
volumes.role: Oracle algorithms through arithmetic, dynamics, block encodings, QSVT and complexity. Core algorithms precede optional spectral/complexity proofs.

volumes.title: Differentiable and Hybrid Quantum Computing
volumes.role: Gradients, optimization, chemistry, QAOA and learning, followed by research-method training and the H2 capstone. Chapter 48 is physically placed here before both capstones need it.

volumes.title: Noise, Error Correction, and Logical Computation
volumes.role: Noise and device characterization through code conditions, decoding, fault tolerance and resources; the finite memory case study closes the route.

volumes.title: Physical Realizations of Quantum Computing
volumes.role: Shared physical bridges and six alternative platform branches. Teach one branch in depth; compare the rest through common contracts.

volumes.title: Quantum Programming, Compilation, and Classical Simulation
volumes.role: Semantics, synthesis, routing, scheduling and control, followed by exact/stabilizer/MPS/tensor-network execution. Core compilation can enter from supplied targets; advanced control/logical branches import selected earlier-volume sections.
